result.title: BlazeVGGT: 13x Faster VGGT at 2,000 Frames via Camera Token without Training
result.summary: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention. However, the resulting all-to-all cross-view computation scales quadratically with the number of input views, making long-sequence inference particularly expensive due to substantial frame-level redundancy among highly overlapping observations. We uncover a topology-first, geometry-later evolution in VGGT camera tokens: shallow-layer tokens reliably capture local view neighborhoods, whereas deeper-layer tokens progressively encode globally organized inter-view geometry. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BlazeVGGT, a training-free framework for structure-aware frame-level key--value sparsification. At each global-attention block, BlazeVGGT constructs a view-level similarity kernel from camera-token relations and employs greedy determinantal point process inference to select a compact set of mutually complementary views. The selected views constitute the key--value context, while all input frames are retained as queries. This asymmetric attention design preserves dense per-frame predictions while eliminating redundant cross-view computation, allowing our method to be directly integrated into pretrained VGGT as a plug-and-play module without parameter updates. Its advantages become increasingly pronounced with sequence length: at 2,000 frames, BlazeVGGT achieves approximately 13$\times$ faster inference than VGGT while reducing the Chamfer Distance from 0.41 to 0.32. Extensive experiments demonstrate a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off in point-cloud reconstruction and camera-pose estimation, compatibility with existing VGGT accelerators such as FastVGGT and LiteVGGT, and transferability to VGGT-based models including StreamVGGT and PAGE-4D. Codes are publicly available at https://github.com/MagiciannnY/BlazeVGGT.git.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发现 VGGT 的 camera token 呈「先拓扑后几何」的层级演化：浅层捕获局部视图邻域，深层逐步编码全局视图间几何；据此提出免训练的 BlazeVGGT，用 camera-token 关系构造视图级相似度核，并以贪心 DPP 选出互补视图作为 KV 上下文、保留全部帧作 query，在 2,000 帧下约 13 倍加速且 Chamfer Distance 更低。
AI.relevance_reason: 按深度解读 token 语义、再用相似度核筛选视觉证据并稀疏 KV 缓存的做法，可能为 LVR 中「latent 相似度受内容、深度与缓存/注意力结构影响」及视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，但其任务是几何重建而非推理，迁移性待查。
